captions.detailed: This 3D model is a sleek, modern cuff bracelet with a tapered, open-loop design. It features a broad, flat front band that gradually narrows in width and thickness toward the open gap at the back. The inner and outer profiles are smooth, concentric curves, forming an elegant oval geometry designed to fit comfortably around a wrist.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric cuff bracelet with an open-back gap. The bracelet should taper from a wide, thick front surface to a narrower, thinner profile at the back ends, allowing customizable sizing, thickness, and gap width.
captions.factory: The bracelet is constructed using a difference() boolean operation. The main body is formed from a scaled cylinder, which is hollowed out by subtracting a smaller, translated, and scaled inner cylinder. A block_cuts module uses rotated cubes to trim the top and bottom edges at an angle, creating the tapered height profile. Finally, a gap_cuts module subtracts a rectangular cube from the back to create the open cuff structure.
